card.name: Spaces and links in chemical property lists
card.fires_on: Mostly a space or small linking word in chemical and element property text, such as the gap between fields in an element data sheet or 'and' after 'water solubility'. Also fires on 'risk' after 'increased the'.

modes.label: Element data sheet gaps
modes.description: The space between listed properties of a chemical element, such as classification, density, and melting point.

modes.label: Linking word after solubility
modes.description: The word 'and' or 'is' joining substance property terms in chemical or hazard descriptions.
